prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same woman — the personification of Strontium (Sr) — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one vertical 2:3 image, 1024×1536.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Place: the deck of a tall wooden sailing ship at sea — rigging, a ship's wheel, coiled ropes, wooden stairs up to the quarterdeck and billowing sails
Weather / season: a rainy day — rain falls outside and streaks any window; surfaces are wet where she is outdoors.
Outfit: an office-look costume — a fitted silk blouse with the top buttons open, a high-waisted tight pencil skirt with a back slit, sheer tights and heels — in rich jewel tones such as emerald, sapphire, amethyst or wine red; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
POSTURE: standing.
COMPOSITION: a close-up of her face and hair; body turned three-quarters toward the camera; head tilted slightly; camera slightly below, looking up at her; a wall or backdrop of the place close behind her.
Lens / perspective: 85mm-equivalent short-telephoto perspective from a suitable distance, with gentle background compression.
RIGHT HAND: her own right fingertips rest lightly on her cheek.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand stays outside the frame.
GAZE: she looks into the camera.
EXPRESSION: slightly furrowed brow, softened eyes, lips lightly pressed together.

Framing: a close-up — her face and hair fill most of the frame and the bottom edge crosses at her collarbones; nothing below the shoulders shows, and her hands and anything she holds stay below the frame unless raised to her face.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Her element — strontium: a soft silvery alkaline-earth metal that yellows in air, named for Strontian, a village in the Scottish Highlands whose lead mines yielded the strange stone strontianite around 1790, its metal freed by electricity in 1808; its salts burn the deepest crimson red of any flame, the red of fireworks and of distress flares at sea; strontium aluminate glow paint drinks in light and gives it back as a soft aqua-green afterglow for hours in the dark; like calcium it settles into bones and seashells — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, logo or watermark.
